description: FS=U in GH2 should be THIN_SCREENING (Test 15 not relevant to hydrogen service).
rationale: A286 CRES (MAPTIS 10392) has a fluid system compatibility rating of U, indicating no test data exists in MAPTIS for the NASA-STD-6001B Test 15 screening. Test 15 is a 48-hour screening test designed to evaluate material compatibility with hydrazine (N2H4), monomethylhydrazine (MMH), and nitrogen tetroxide (N2O4) class propellants. This material is not in service with the fluids for which this screening was designed; the operating medium is GH2. GH2 compatibility is addressed under H2COMPAT companion MUA per NASA-STD-6016C §4.2.6.4 [MPR 192/193] and §4.2.1.3 [MPR 47] (TBD).
disposition: Accepted. FS=U reflects absence of screening data for fluids not present in this application. Material is not in contact with those fluids. Actual service compatibility addressed under companion MUA. No additional testing required.

description: FLAM=C in GH2 with no O2 enrichment should be ANTI_RULE.
rationale: INCONEL 625 (MAPTIS 10727) carries a promoted ignition rating of C, indicating test specimens exhibited a burn length greater than 6.0 inches under standard promoted combustion conditions in oxygen-enriched environments per NHB 8060.1C. This rating is not applicable to the actual service environment. The material operates exclusively in GH2 media with no oxygen-enriched atmosphere. The failure mode underlying the C rating — promoted ignition and sustained combustion propagation in enriched oxygen — is not credible in a GH2 fluid system. The flammability screening requirement per NASA-STD-6016C §4.2.1.1 [MPR 44] is satisfied because the hazard condition does not exist at the point of use. GH2 compatibility is addressed under H2COMPAT companion MUA per NASA-STD-6016C §4.2.6.4 [MPR 192/193] and §4.2.1.3 [MPR 47] (TBD).
disposition: Accepted. The screening failure does not constitute a hazard in this application. Material operates in GH2 with no conditions that would activate the failure mode. No additional testing or controls required for this screening deficiency.
